candidates.title: Why Orcas Give Up Their Kill When Pilot Whales Show Up
candidates.concept: Brief hero: a tight wall of black round-headed pilot whales charging left to right; ahead of them a big orca fleeing out of frame with a sweat drop; tiny Doug in the orca costume (cap on top) between the two, looking back at the pod

candidates.title: Why Orcas Leave Their Kill to Get Away From Pilot Whales
candidates.concept: An orca porpoising out of frame, a half-eaten fish dropping behind it; the pilot whale wall porpoising after it; Doug in the orca costume left floating in the middle

candidates.title: How Doug Would Die Dressed as an Orca Among Pilot Whales
candidates.concept: Real orcas porpoising away; Doug in the orca costume gets about a centimetre of air; the wall of black heads behind him turns his way (no contact shown)

candidates.title: Off Iceland, Pilot Whales Chase the Scariest Hunter at Sea
candidates.concept: Iceland coastline; dozens of round black heads converging on a lone orca that is already turning to leave; Doug in his cap on a whale-watching boat, binoculars up

candidates.title: Why the Scariest Hunter at Sea Backs Off From Pilot Whales
candidates.concept: A crude chalk family tree of identical round black heads (grandmother with a grey patch on top) facing one orca; Doug in the orca costume next to the orca, waving

candidates.title: Scientists Saw Orcas Drop Their Kill and Flee Pilot Whales
candidates.concept: Orcas leaping clear of the water racing out of frame, speed lines, a dropped fish mid-air; pilot whales leaping after them; Doug in the costume still in the water

candidates.title: Why Pilot Whales Swim Toward the Scariest Sound in the Sea
candidates.concept: Doug in the orca costume holding an underwater speaker with red sound waves, pleased; round black heads gathering around him from every side

candidates.title: How Pilot Whales Make Iceland's Scariest Hunters Leave
candidates.concept: A pod led by a grey-patched grandmother pushing across the bay; orca fins heading out; Doug in the orca costume caught between, sweat drop

candidates.title: Why Orcas Give Up a Kill Rather Than Face Pilot Whales
candidates.concept: An orca swimming away from a fish it was eating as the pilot whale wall arrives; no contact; Doug in the orca costume reaching for the abandoned fish

candidates.title: Why the Scariest Hunters at Sea Leave When Pilot Whales Come
candidates.concept: The empty bay; the orca costume floating flat with the cap on top; the pilot whale pod circling it once
